verdict: Paid ads have been dark five days; pipeline conversion needs immediate attention.
narrative: Meta advertising stopped running on September 9th and has had zero spend through September 13th, meaning your practice has had no paid lead flow for five consecutive days. Over the full 28-day window, $1,408.56 in ad spend produced 30 leads at $46.95 per lead — a cost per lead above your stronger weeks earlier this summer, and one that cannot improve while the campaign is paused. Separately, of those 30 leads, only 24 appear in your CRM with zero opportunities created, which points to a gap in how leads are being received and actioned after they arrive — that is an intake issue, not an ads issue. Ads are being reactivated this week, and the intake handoff is being audited in parallel so that when spend resumes, leads move into your pipeline correctly. Expect lead volume to recover once the campaign is live; the pipeline gap is the number to watch alongside it.

highlights.phrase: consecutive days with zero ad spend, September 9–13
leads received this 28-day period at $46.95 each
opportunities created in your CRM from those 30 leads this period

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not converting into CRM opportunities — 30 leads in, zero opportunities created, indicating a broken intake handoff.
watch_item.fix: The intake workflow is being audited and corrected now, alongside campaign reactivation, so leads entering next week are tracked and actioned from the moment they arrive.
